title: Summarise a README
blurb: Short. Inline input_file, one artifact. Good for compare mode.
prompt: Summarise README.md in three bullets and save summary.md.

inputFile.content:
# tinyq

tinyq is a tiny job queue for Bun and Node. Jobs live in SQLite, so a crash never loses work.

## Features
- `enqueue(name, payload, { runAt, retries })` with exponential backoff
- Workers pull with `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` semantics emulated in SQLite
- A 40-line dashboard at `/tinyq` shows queued, running and failed jobs

## Limits
Single process only. No priorities yet. Payloads must be JSON-serialisable.
